name: publicWeb_getKennels
description: Returns the URL slug for every live kennel (deleted = 0, removed = 0) that has a HC.KennelWebsite row. Used by the Next.js sitemap index to generate per-kennel sitemap references at build / revalidation time. No authentication. Read-only.

rowsets.name: KennelSlugs
rowsets.description: One row per kennel with a KennelWebsite row, ordered alphabetically by slug.

columns.name: Slug
columns.description: HC.Kennel.KennelUniqueShortName — the URL path segment for this kennel

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW in the CATCH.

codeSmells.detail: Returns kennels that have a KennelWebsite row regardless of whether Enabled = 1. Kennels with Enabled = 0 (website disabled/under construction) will appear in the sitemap. Consider adding AND kw.Enabled = 1 to the WHERE clause.
The CATCH (line 32) logs ErrorName 'Unhandled error in getKennels' and HcVersion '<unknown>'. ProcName is correct.

breakingChangeRules: Never rename Slug — the Next.js getStaticParams caller expects this exact column name
